dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature with a pronounced recurve from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology at the highest morphological point; classified as obtuse-rounded.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a steep incline relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Proportional vertical height to maximum visible horizontal base width is approximately 1.1:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small morphological indentation or nick visible near the dorsal fin apex; faint linear vertical striations present on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharp bimodal color transition from dark charcoal dorsal pigmentation to a stark white lateral field; numerous small high-luminance circular artifacts scattered across the dorsal surface.
